description: This file is a shell script containing a series of automated tests for Git's handling of repository fetches and pushes involving ref namespaces. It sets up test repositories, performs push and pull operations with ref namespace configurations, and verifies the correctness of ref handling, including hiding refs, cloning, and protocol behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided shell commands and checking for successful completion.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output from a command or file is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a git configuration for a repository.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output, expecting matches.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's fake timestamp or performs other timing-related setup.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script execution.
